name: TC-916: 3DS completed through a full-page redirect — /checkout/return finishes the order
description: The bank check as a real redirect: Stripe's hosted 3DS page → COMPLETE → Stripe sends the browser to wind's /checkout/return with payment_intent and payment_intent_client_secret (Stripe's hosted page adds source_type=card, not redirect_status). The return page strips them from the address bar, calls POST /api/stripe/confirm-payment once, clears the cart and lands on /order-confirmation/<the order>. Same backend checks as TC-914.
